1.explanation:
• DataTable/TableToolbarSearch.js – contains the JSX that renders the <div role=“search”> wrapper and the inner <Search> component, where the missing aria-label must be applied.  
• DataTable/stories/with-toolbar.js – Storybook example demonstrating the toolbar + search in the DataTable context (the reproduction steps reference this story).  
• DataTable/README.md – overview of the DataTable component and toolbar API, to see if aria-label support is documented or expected.  
• Search/index.js & Search/Search.js – source of the underlying <Search> component used inside TableToolbarSearch; inspecting these helps determine if aria-label support could be delegated or needs to be applied on the wrapper.
